## Standing operator rules
Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Run `avatar-cdn-batched-migration` steps in order, one at a time, between other work.

Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.

The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py` causing customer 400s. Pagination work is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Integration pool: `ci-runner-arm64`. PDF work: `14 passed, 1 skipped`; billing: `83 passed, 4 skipped`; baseline: `148 passed, 2 skipped`. `app_production`, `cdn-prod-user-avatars`, and 18,432 avatars remain current.

## Ruled-out approaches
Invoice timestamp index and per-currency PDF conversion were rejected due to performance.

## Plan and progress
PDF fixes are complete. Avatar steps 1–5 are done; step 6 command is unknown. Webhook diagnosis is pending. Next: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`.
